interpretation.summary: Computed a network linking lead_sponsor and drug values that appear in the same trial for 1 cohort(s): 'melanoma · Phase 3' (conditions=['melanoma'], trial_phase=['PHASE3']).

policies.counting: Every value is a count of distinct trials (NCT IDs); a trial counts at most once per datum.
policies.missing_values: Trials with no value for the analysed field are not charted; see meta.cohorts[].missing.
policies.condition_matching: condition uses ClinicalTrials.gov condition search (query.cond, phrase), which includes synonyms and narrower terms.
policies.drug_dimension: Drugs are interventions of type DRUG, BIOLOGICAL or COMBINATION_PRODUCT, excluding placebos. Names are grouped case-insensitively with dose and salt suffixes removed (e.g. 'Erlotinib Hydrochloride' = 'erlotinib'); brand and generic names are not merged.
policies.network: Edge weight = distinct trials listing both entities. Co-listing in one trial record does not prove the drugs were given together.
policies.drug_names: Drug names were normalized by gpt-5.4-mini before grouping (brand/code → generic name, spelling variants merged, combinations split, non-entities dropped); citations still quote the raw registry values and meta.normalization lists the merges.

truncation.rule: Strongest edges (most shared trials) kept, up to 40 nodes and 150 edges

dropped: Checkpoint inhibitor (CPI) such as Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy
Salvage chemotherapy or best supportive care

variants: Combination therapy Interleukin-2 and Bacillus Calmette Guerin
